title: Croydon Pressure
description: A dark half-time dubstep roller at 140 that breathes at 70 — a cavernous OberheimDMX kick and snare hold the centre while a crushed sub-bass wobble grinds underneath. An early peak of grinding bass and a chopped vocal cut gives way to a deconstructed outro of pure sub and space.
code:
setcpm(140/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.95).room(0.3),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*2").s("triangle")
      .lpf(sine.slow(8).range(120, 420)).gain(0.85)
      .shape(0.3)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.95).room(0.25),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.5).swingBy(0.18, 8).cut(1),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("triangle")
      .lpf(sine.range(150, 900).fast(2).mul(perlin.range(0.6, 1)))
      .gain(saw.fast(2).range(0.4, 1))
      .crush(7).shape(0.35).gain(0.85)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(1).room(0.25)
      .every(8, x => x.ply("<1 1 2>")),
    s("hh(7,8,3)").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.55).swingBy(0.2, 8).cut(1)
      .sometimesBy(0.2, x => x.speed(2)),
    s("~ ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.5).room(0.4),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("triangle")
      .lpf(sine.range(180, 1400).fast(4).mul(perlin.range(0.5, 1)))
      .gain(saw.fast(4).range(0.35, 1))
      .crush(6).shape(0.45).gain(0.9),
    s("think").chop(8).slice(8, "0 2 1 3 4 6 5 7").speed("<1 1.5 0.5>")
      .gain(0.55).lpf(2000).room(0.4).delay(".4:.125:.6")
      .off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.4))
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<[c2,eb2,g2] [ab1,c2,eb2] [bb1,d2,f2] [g1,bb1,d2]>").s("swpad")
      .gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.3, 0.7)).lpf(1100).room(0.6).shape(0.2),
    note("<c1 eb1 g0 ab0>*2").s("triangle")
      .lpf(sine.slow(8).range(120, 500)).gain(0.8).shape(0.3),
    s("~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.7).room(0.5)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(1).room(0.25)
      .every(4, x => x.ply("<1 2 1 4>")),
    s("hh(7,8,1)").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.55).swingBy(0.2, 8).cut(1)
      .sometimesBy(0.25, x => x.speed(2)),
    s("~ cp ~ ~ ~ ~ cp ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.5).room(0.4),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*8").s("triangle")
      .lpf(sine.range(200, 1800).fast(8).mul(perlin.range(0.4, 1)))
      .gain(saw.fast(8).range(0.3, 1))
      .crush(5).shape(0.5).gain(0.9),
    s("think").chop(8).slice(8, "0 4 2 6 1 5 3 7").speed("<1.5 1 0.5>")
      .gain(0.5).lpf(2500).room(0.4).delay(".4:.125:.6")
      .every(4, x => x.rev())
  )],
  [12, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*2").s("triangle")
      .lpf(sine.slow(8).range(110, 380)).gain(0.85).shape(0.3),
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").bank("OberheimDMX").gain(0.85).room(0.4)
  )]
)
